roles.agent_a: Owns the code, the tests, the guardrails, the migration scripts, and the CI. Agent A produces the PR description, the diff narrative, the rollback procedure, and the test results.
roles.agent_b: Owns the B-track governance pack. Agent B checks governance/evidence readiness only. Agent B does not approve code correctness. Agent B applies this checklist to each Phase 53 PR.
roles.user: Approves merge and sign-off decisions. User has the final say on proceed / stop decisions.

proceed_conditions: CI workflow test is passing on the PR's head commit.
CI workflow Parity Guardrails (Phase 51F) is passing on the PR's head commit.
All structural guardrails (G1-G6) are passing on the PR's head commit.
All behavior guardrail tests (21 baseline + per-PR additions) are passing on the PR's head commit.
The PR's diff narrative describes the change, the rationale, and the rollback procedure.
The PR's affected must-pin items (per the B26 tracker) are accounted for in the PR's pin tests.
The PR's auto-merge class (per the B25 policy) is consistent with the PR's actual auto-merge status.
Agent B has been notified of the PR.
The PR does not violate the do-not-parallelize rules.
The PR is in the correct Phase 53 sequence position.
stop_conditions: Any must-pin item is broken or failing the pin test.
Any structural guardrail (G1-G6) is broken or failing the enforcement test.
Any behavior guardrail test is failing.
CI workflow test is failing on the PR's head commit.
CI workflow Parity Guardrails (Phase 51F) is failing on the PR's head commit.
The Phase 53 refactor order is violated.
The PR is merged with a non-passing check.
The PR touches a file outside the Agent A-owned file set.

The PR includes a paid pilot authorization claim, an external validation claim, a customer reference claim, a production-readiness claim, an enterprise SaaS-readiness claim, a bankability / audit / certification / lender / regulatory / SaaS claim, an investment advice claim, or a guaranteed returns claim.
manual_review_triggers: The PR's auto-merge class is review_required (Group A-2 or C).
The PR's diff includes changes to app/persistence/* files.
The PR's diff includes changes to repository.py.
The PR's diff includes changes to app/services/*.
The PR's diff includes changes to the test files.
The PR's title includes REVIEW REQUIRED or DRAFT, REVIEW REQUIRED.
sign_off_triggers: The PR's auto-merge class is sign_off_required (Group B).
The PR is a Phase 53 closeout (53G-8, 53H-2, 53I-4, 53J).
The PR touches a must-pin item that is currently marked as pilot_blocker: yes or paid_pilot_blocker: yes.
The PR is the first PR in a new Phase 53 group.
rollback_escalation_triggers: The PR breaks a parity-core lock (4 SHA-256 files).
The PR breaks an engine-output golden (TUHO or Oborovo).
The PR produces a model output drift on TUHO or Oborovo.
The PR breaks a financial formula.
The PR produces a JS financial calculation change.
The PR produces a fixture CSV change.
The PR produces a schema / migration change that was not pre-authorized.
The PR is merged without Agent B's notification.
The PR is the 53J final closeout and any hard-stop condition is unclear.
no_parallelization_checks: The PR is not in a do-not-parallelize area (Group B, Group C, Group A-2 writes, or the persistence layer migration) — or, if it is, the PR is reviewed with sign-off per the B25 auto-merge policy.
The PR is not run in parallel with a conflicting PR.
The PR does not modify the persistence layer migration script.
single_owner_zone_checks: The PR's affected files are all in the single-owner zones for the PR's group.
The PR does not modify files in a different single-owner zone without coordination with the other zone's owner.

guardrail_failure_responses.G2_failure: The PR is blocked. The PR introduces a service import in main_web.py or main_api.py. The PR is rolled back if merged.
guardrail_failure_responses.G3_failure: The PR is blocked. The PR introduces a sqlite3.Connection or sqlite3.connect instantiation outside app/persistence/*. The PR is rolled back if merged.
guardrail_failure_responses.G4_failure: The PR is blocked. The PR introduces a direct get_cursor import in a service or route. The PR is rolled back if merged.
guardrail_failure_responses.G5_failure: The PR is blocked. The PR breaks the single-transaction pattern in repository.py. The PR is rolled back if merged.
guardrail_failure_responses.G6_failure: The PR is blocked. The PR uses a private attribute or function of the repository from a service. The PR is rolled back if merged.

guardrail_failure_responses.deferred_guardrail_d1_d4_implemented: The PR is documented in B27 and the guardrail is added to the active guardrail list.

decision_tree: 1. Are all hard-stop conditions clear? No -> Stop. Escalate to user. Yes -> Continue.
2. Is the PR's auto-merge class sign_off_required? Yes -> User sign-off required. Escalate to user. No -> Continue.
3. Is the PR's auto-merge class review_required? Yes -> Agent B performs manual review. Are all review conditions clear? Yes -> Recommend proceed. No -> Stop. Escalate to user. No -> Continue.
4. Is the PR's auto-merge class auto_merge_allowed? Yes -> Recommend proceed. Agent B notes the recommendation in the B32 evidence intake record. No -> Stop. Escalate to user.
global_notes: Agent B does not approve code correctness. Agent B checks governance/evidence readiness only. Agent A owns code and tests. User approves merge/sign-off decisions.
The checklist is conservative. It is biased toward stopping or escalating rather than proceeding. The default response to a hard-stop condition is to stop and escalate, not to proceed.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
